case.title: Renewal of the ball bearing 6306 agreement
case.briefing: You negotiate for Hollerau Pumpenwerke with Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH. Renewal of the ball bearing 6306 agreement. Need: 20000 pc a year. Category goal: routine: fewer suppliers and less process cost. Score: the lowest total cost C as defined in the rules, valued with this case's rates (need lead time 7 days). Fallback if you walk away: the second-source quote quote:7200004. Must-haves: none. Prepare from the data package.

sup:70620.text:
Dear customer,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. We are delighted to assist Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH and remain eager to serve all your requirements from our extensive product range.

We are pleased to submit our offer at a price of €4.96 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel 30 days net, and a contract term of 12 months. This offer stays valid for 30 days.

To give you complete visibility into our underlying costs, please note that LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 10 % of our cost. Furthermore, PPI-C2815 rose 0.8 % in twelve months and is 65 % of our cost. 

As your trusted partner, we pride ourselves on exceptional distributor service and look forward to continuing our successful business relationship.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Florian Gruber
Inside Sales, Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH

move.subject: Re: Quote from Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH: Renewal of the ball bearing 6306 agreement
move.body:
Dear colleagues at Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH,

Thank you for your quote and for explaining your position.

Your on-time delivery over the last four quarters was 85.0% (sc:70620@2026Q3). Our demand forecast for this part has changed +4.2% (fc:360020@2026-09).

We have analysed the cost situation of this part carefully; the options below reflect that analysis.

We can offer either of these packages - please choose the one that suits you better:
Option A: EUR 4.49 per unit, payment 90 days net, 24-month agreement.
Option B: EUR 4.43 per unit, payment 30 days net, 24-month agreement.
Option C: EUR 4.45 per unit, payment 45 days net, 24-month agreement.

Could you share a cost breakdown for this part - material, conversion, overhead?

We look forward to your view on these options.

Kind regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

move.text:
Dear customer,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We have reviewed your options and the provided data regarding delivery and volume. As to the delivery record and volume change data you cited, that does not change our position. Material accounts for about 65 % of our cost; more detail we do not share. 

Unfortunately, we are unable to accommodate the requested price levels. Our current Angebot stands at a price of €4.94 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a contract term of 24 months. 

As an alternative, we can agree to a 24-month contract with 30 days net payment terms at a price of €4.88 per unit. We also have another option offering a price of €4.88 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 24 months. 

Please note that our offer stays valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Florian Gruber
Inside Sales, Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH

move.subject: Re: Quote from Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH: Renewal of the ball bearing 6306 agreement
move.body:
Dear colleagues at Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH,

Thank you for your message and for telling us what matters to you.

We are ready to move on the terms you care about if the price reflects it - each option below is a different trade, so you can choose what helps you most.

We can offer either of these packages - please choose the one that suits you better:
Option A: EUR 4.52 per unit, 24-month agreement, payment 90 days net.
Option B: EUR 4.52 per unit, 36-month agreement, payment 90 days net.

Which volume or contract length would let you improve the price further?

Please tell us which option suits you best.

Kind regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

move.text:
Dear customer,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We have considered your options, but neither a longer contract term nor increased volume allows us to reduce the price further. 

We must therefore maintain our previous offer of a price of €4.94 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a contract term of 24 months. Our general terms and conditions apply; the quote lists our standard terms. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

A binding higher volume would help us and can improve the price. Which volume can you commit to? We value our partnership and look forward to hearing from you.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Florian Gruber
Inside Sales, Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH

move.subject: Re: Quote from Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH: Renewal of the ball bearing 6306 agreement
move.body:
Dear colleagues at Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH,

Thank you for your message - it is always a pleasure to hear from you.

We would rather spend our time making good pumps together than exchanging e-mails about cents, so we have tried to make the options below easy to say yes to. We can commit to over 24 months, as set out in the term sheets.

We can offer either of these packages - please choose the one that suits you better:
Option A: EUR 4.58 per unit, 24-month agreement, payment 90 days net.
Option B: EUR 4.58 per unit, 36-month agreement, payment 90 days net.

We look forward to your reply and to many more years of good cooperation.

Kind regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

move.text:
Dear customer,

We appreciate your continued interest and your revised offer. It is always a pleasure working with your team, and we greatly value your partnership and our ongoing business relationship with Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH.

However, we are unable to accommodate the requested price levels and must maintain our offer of €4.94 per unit. This remains our best possible price for the 24-month agreement with 90 days net payment terms. 

To confirm, our offer stands at a price of €4.94 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a contract term of 24 months. Please note that this is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide within the next 7 days, as our offer stays valid for 7 days. We hope to continue serving you from our extensive inventory and premium range.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Florian Gruber
Inside Sales, Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH
